notes.title: Update 1.0.9 is available now
notes.content:
Fixes and improvements added in this update:

- The option to save and quit in the pause menu has been changed, now you can choose between just saving or quit.

- Autosave has been added.

- Kneeling condition of the player has been removed, now it is possible to crawl without having to kneel.

- Bug fixes and performance improvements.
